drivingQuestion: What does the mishna's closing clause 'this is the principle' add beyond the tereifot it already listed?
outcomeNote: The clause is explained as including the seven amoraic tereifot rulings; nothing is left standing.

segments.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל, לְאֵתוֹיֵי מַאי? לְאֵתוֹיֵי שַׁב שְׁמַעְתָּתָא.
segments.en: § The mishna states: «This is the principle:» Any animal that was injured such that an animal in a similar condition could not live for an extended period is a tereifa. The Gemara asks: «What» case does this principle «add» that was not previously mentioned? The Gemara responds: It was stated «to add seven halakhot» of tereifot taught by amora’im and not listed in the mishna. These cases are enumerated on 42b.
